thread:
maya: Quick headcount on the 'Performance Plus' packaging ask from two customers. They want a 'throughput add-on' tied to specific model routes with SLAs. We need to decide: per-route add-on vs per-tenant slot allocation.

tom: Per-route add-on technically possible but will complicate accounting and autoscaler. Per-tenant slots are cleaner for infra.

rahul: From Product POV, customers asked explicitly for per-route control so they can prioritize search over chat. Suggest hybrid: primary allocation per-tenant with optional per-route reservation for pilot customers.
sophia: Pricing input: if we allow per-route reservations, we should charge a premium (>=25%) to compensate fragmentation and scheduler overhead.

maya: Risk note: per-route reservations can cause underutilization unless we implement borrowing rules. Need clear borrow/backfill policy.
amanda: Sales wants simple catalog: tiers + addons. Recommend 'Performance Plus' as an addon SKU with two purchase modes: dedicated slots or route reservations (pilot only).

acct-bot: Action: create sku ID = PERF-PLUS-2026, initial list price = $1500/mo for 4 dedicated slots. Route-reserve price = +30%.

maya: Launch criteria proposal: - >2 paying pilots, - infra autoscaler latency SLO unaffected, - billing reconciliation verified in test invoices, - docs + FAQ live.

tom: Dev tasks: autoscaler changes, billing meter changes to support route metadata, quota engine to allow borrowing. Estimate 2 sprints.

rahul: Prioritization: slot-based addon fits into next planning cadence; route-reserve pilot deferred to post-launch unless sales signs up 2 pilots needing it immediately.

sophia: Also propose a short-term mitigation: offer high-priority routing via weighted routing (no hard reservation) at lower price point.

maya: Ok team: follow-up owners: @tom infra prototype, @amanda draft pricing page, @rahul pilot acceptance checklist, @sophia update ratecard. Check-ins next Tue.

amanda: I'll prep a one-pager for sales with talking points and the borrowing rules.

maya: Thanks all :pray:
